description: Gross Operating Hours: sums jfb_daily_activities duration for a project+date range, optionally filtered down to one equipment unit / area / pass / tsca / attachment combo. Every activity counts, regardless of delay_code_id. Companion to dvw-jfb-noh-v2 (same filters, only delay_code_id IS NULL activities). Split into two single-purpose views, same convention as dvw-jfb-metric-cy-v2 / dvw-jfb-metric-sf-v2, instead of one view returning both columns. Area, pass, TSCA and attachment are the activity's EFFECTIVE values (tr/ea laterals): an activity with no area of its own takes all four from the latest TRANSITION marker on the same equipment and report_date at or before its start, and one with its own area keeps it but takes the marker's attachment when it has none -- the non-native app's buildCombosFromEvents rule, mirrored client-side in src/lib/transitionState.js. Change one and you must change the other.
direct_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (da.end_date_time - da.start_date_time)) / 3600.0), 0) AS goh_hours FROM usdf.jfb_daily_activities da LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t.area, t.pass_type, t.tsca, t.attachment_id FROM usdf.jfb_daily_activities t WHERE (NOT (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') OR da.attachment_id IS NULL) AND upper(btrim(t.category)) = 'TRANSITION' AND t.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND t.project_id = da.project_id AND t.equipment_id = da.equipment_id AND t.report_date = da.report_date AND t.start_date_time <= da.start_date_time ORDER BY t.start_date_time DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 1) tr ON true CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN da.area ELSE tr.area END AS area, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN da.pass_type ELSE tr.pass_type END AS pass_type, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN da.tsca ELSE tr.tsca END AS tsca, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN COALESCE(da.attachment_id, tr.attachment_id) ELSE tr.attachment_id END AS attachment_id) ea WHERE da.project_id = p_project_id AND da.start_date_time::date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND (p_equipment_id IS NULL OR da.equipment_id = p_equipment_id) AND (ea.area->>'area_id')::uuid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_area_id AND ea.pass_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_pass_type AND ea.tsca IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_tsca AND ea.attachment_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_attachment_id AND da.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE

parameters.name: p_project_id
parameters.description: Project to scope the sum to.

parameters.name: p_start_date
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the activity date range (compared against start_date_time::date).

parameters.name: p_end_date
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the activity date range.

parameters.name: p_equipment_id
parameters.description: Equipment scope filter. Null includes all equipment (a broader-scope choice, not a combo dimension).

parameters.name: p_area_id
parameters.description: Combo identity dimension, matched exactly (IS NOT DISTINCT FROM against jfb_daily_activities.area->>'area_id') -- pass the row's own area_id, or null to match only activities with no area set (the 'Unassigned' bucket). Null here does NOT mean 'all areas'.

parameters.name: p_pass_type
parameters.description: Combo identity dimension, matched exactly including null -- pass the row's own pass_type, or null to match only activities with no pass_type set.

parameters.name: p_tsca
parameters.description: Combo identity dimension, matched exactly including null -- pass the row's own tsca, or null to match only activities with tsca unset.

parameters.name: p_attachment_id
parameters.description: Combo identity dimension, matched exactly including null -- pass the row's own attachment_id, or null to match only activities with no attachment set.

columns.name: goh_hours
columns.description: Gross Operating Hours -- summed duration of every matching activity; 0 when none match.
